messages.subject: Scalar-on-image regression problems with INLA
parts:
Dear INLA group,

Apologies, for the very general question but I am curious if there are any examples where INLA has been applied in combination with SPDE priors in a scalar-on-image regression problem? 

I'm familiar with work by Mejia et al. 2020 (https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.2019.1611582), which is an image-on-scalar regression problem. However, I'm struggling to find examples where the outcome is a scalar quantity and the inputs consists of one or more images (e.g. cortical surface MRI) and other scalar input variables? 

Please get in touch if you know of any resources and/or implementations!

Many thanks for your help!

Best wishes,
Anna
